result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign or Signable**, depending on how often you send contracts and how much you want to spend.

My advice is not to pay for an expensive enterprise platform if all you need is to send contracts, get them signed electronically, and automatically store completed copies.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

Here are the five I'd shortlist in 2026\:

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — Best overall for simplicity**

(My top pick for straightforward signing)

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable templates and signing reminders.
- Audit trails and signed document storage.
- Integrates with Dropbox and other business tools.

Best for: Small businesses sending everyday contracts and agreements.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign — Best established platform**

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Excellent document tracking.
- Templates, automated workflows and integrations.
- Suitable as your business grows.

Best for: Businesses signing contracts regularly with external customers.

Website: [DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Signable — Best UK-focused option**

- UK-based e-signature provider.
- Straightforward document signing.
- Templates and automated reminders.
- Pay-per-envelope options available.

Best for: UK small businesses wanting a simpler, locally focused service.

Website: [Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc — Best for proposals and contracts**

- Create professional proposals and quotes.
- Add pricing tables and branding.
- Collect electronic signatures.
- Track when customers open documents.

Best for: Sales businesses, consultants and agencies.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Zoho Sign - Apps Documentation](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SUcET-87d95vVganDQlyhWq-yiws-wQ_od0uceT-oSgYYMR06035CJR-_lwRhqFA2Wk42Qb4rsaFUnfX59ev935AI6sAEgF3T2dA_v2J3qmxQzTtV0tKWD6AvgqazINgryECCXcm3UqYqzrO6XPMiLUxQFIqLMyy4JMl92yn0HiutGHZpNfO5gb5ETOux07n?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Zoho Sign — Best budget-friendly option**

- Good value for smaller teams.
- Document templates and signing workflows.
- Integrates with Zoho CRM and other Zoho products.
- Has a free entry-level option.

Best for: Start-ups and businesses keeping software costs low.

Website: [Zoho Sign](https://www.zoho.com/sign/)

## My comparison

| Software | Best feature | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Simplicity | Best everyday choice |
| DocuSign | Integrations | Best established option |
| Signable | UK focus | Great UK alternative |
| PandaDoc | Proposals | Best for sales |
| Zoho Sign | Affordability | Best budget choice |


## What should you look for?

For a small business, I'd prioritise\:

- Legally useful audit trails and completion certificates.
- Unlimited or generous document sending.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Automatic signing reminders.
- Secure document storage.
- GDPR and data protection provisions.
- Ability to sign on mobile phones.

For UK businesses, ordinary electronic signatures are generally admissible as evidence and can be used for many commercial contracts, although certain documents have additional execution requirements. search_results.title: The best e-signature software in 2026
search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
